_comment: SINGLE WRITER for 0.8.20 release state (DOC-HYGIENE-2 T2a). THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE THESE FACTS ARE AUTHORED: landed slices + their landing SHAs, the SCHEMA version, the next slice, the remaining ladder, AC status, and the ruled/unruled decision set. WHY: before this file, that state was narrated across a 5-12 file write-side fan-out (the master release plan, the STATUS board, the plan, the Steward hand-off, the ledgers) with NOTHING checking that the copies agreed - one reconciliation commit (b70629e5) had to touch 7 files, and the live board is ~79 KB, too large to read whole. HOW IT IS ENFORCED: `generated_views` below names the marker-delimited regions that are RENDERED from this file by scripts/check-release-state-views.sh. That script regenerates each region into a temp buffer and diffs it against what is in the document; any difference is a HARD failure, so a hand-edit of a view, or a change here without a regenerate, both go red. Regenerate with `scripts/check-release-state-views.sh --write`. TO CHANGE A FACT: edit it HERE, then run --write, then commit both. Do NOT hand-edit inside the markers. SCOPE: this file records state, it does not decide anything - it changes no release slot, no scope, no requirement and no AC. Every fact below was re-verified from git (merge-commit ancestry on origin/main; `pub const SCHEMA_VERSION` in src/rust/crates/fathomdb-schema/src/lib.rs) rather than copied from narration.
landed_verified_how: each SHA below is the landing merge commit for its slice AND is an ancestor of origin/main (git merge-base --is-ancestor), with the merge subject matching this repo's `merge(0.8.20): Slice[- ]N` landing convention
